title: High-Dimensional Structured Light Tomography with a Tilted Lens
abstract: In this work, we investigate high-dimensional spatial mode tomography using intensity measurements and the astigmatic transformation implemented with a tilted lens. We improve the method previously published in Ref. [1] to perform the spatial tomography not restricted to a fixed order, which allowed us to achieve good fidelity for a mode space dimension as high as $D=66\,$. Since the literature is not unanimous, we also present a comprehensive revision of light propagation through a tilted lens for an accurate description of the transformation used for tomography. We derive its effective focal lengths, and analyze its role as an astigmatic mode converter. Moreover, we establish its explicit domain of validity within the Hermite-Gaussian basis.

summaries.en: The paper improves high-dimensional spatial-mode tomography using intensity measurements and a tilted-lens astigmatic transformation, revising the tilted-lens propagation theory, deriving effective focal lengths and the converter’s validity within the Hermite–Gaussian basis to enable accurate tomography up to D=66 with high fidelity without restricting to a fixed mode order.
summaries.zh: 本文改进了利用强度测量并由倾斜透镜实现的像散变换来进行高维空间模态层析的方法，重新修正了倾斜透镜的光传播理论、推导其等效焦距并分析其作为像散模态转换器的作用与在Hermite–Gaussian基底中的适用范围，从而不局限于固定阶次地实现高保真层析，并将模空间维度提升至D=66。

title: A fast and accurate model for gradient-based inverse design of multimode waveguides
abstract: Multimode photonic inverse design requires fast, accurate computational models that provide geometry gradients. Based on coupled-mode theory (CMT), we propose a differentiable surrogate model. Its parameter-extraction method uses a change of modal basis to obtain coupled-mode parameters from cross-sectional mode data. We also provide a complete, easy-to-implement propagation and optimization workflow. Using finite-difference time-domain (FDTD) simulation data as a common reference, we compare the prediction accuracy of our model and forward dataset-based eigenmode expansion (EME) for randomly generated thin-film lithium niobate (TFLN) waveguide profiles that traverse modal coupling regions. Using identical modal libraries, the model reduces the maximum per-mode mean absolute transmission error by 17-37% compared with forward EME. We demonstrate a spot-size converter design that preserves the fundamental TM$_0$ mode in its hybridization region with the first-order TE$_1$ mode and obtain nine structures, each with FDTD-verified transmission above 98%. These tests demonstrate the model's utility for large-scale photonic inverse design, enabling rapid exploration of the design parameter space by combining gradient information with improved prediction accuracy.

summaries.en: The paper presents a differentiable coupled-mode-theory surrogate model with modal-basis parameter extraction and an end-to-end workflow that, compared with forward EME on FDTD-referenced data, improves per-mode transmission prediction accuracy by 17–37% and enables gradient-based inverse design of multimode multimode waveguides, demonstrated via a spot-size converter yielding nine FDTD-verified designs with >98% transmission.
summaries.zh: 本文提出一种基于耦合模理论（CMT）的可微分替代模型，通过改变模态基对从截面模态数据中提取耦合模参数，并给出完整易实现的传播与优化流程；在以FDTD为参考的随机薄膜铌酸锂（TFLN）波导剖面评测中，相较前向EME将每个模态的平均绝对传输误差降低17–37%，并通过保持混合区域中TM0基模与一阶TE1模混合的聚斑尺寸转换器示例，获得9个经FDTD验证传输率均超过98%的结构，证明该模型适用于大规模光子反向设计并可利用梯度信息加速参数空间探索。

title: High-fidelity six-dimensional optical data storage
abstract: Multi-dimensional optical data storage, wherein each voxel encodes multiple bits of information within a three-dimensional isotropic medium, presents a revolutionary approach to dense data storage. This approach exploits multiple degrees of freedom of light, such as intensity, polarization and wavelength, to selectively control distinct optical responses in the medium. However, increasing dimensionality exacerbates crosstalk between different encoding dimensions, thereby compromising recording fidelity. In this study, we introduce a novel six-dimensional (6D) multiplexing approach that exploits ultrafast interactions of polarized light with a three-dimensional medium. By manipulating three light parameters within a Poincaré-like semi-sphere, we systematically induce three distinct material responses in laser-induced nanostructures, each corresponding to a unique physical quantity: fluorescence, phase retardance, and slow axis orientation. Thanks to such multiple one-to-one correspondence between light parameters and material responses, we achieve unprecedented high fidelity, attaining a raw accuracy of 99.45%. Furthermore, this independently controlled 6D multiplexing technique maximizes the effective user capacity to 0.38 petabits per disc. The versatility of laser-induced nanostructures across multiple physical dimensions enables diverse applications, ranging from high-capacity data storage to microfluidics, optical elements, integrated photonics, micromechanics, and quantum technologies.

summaries.en: The paper proposes a high-fidelity six-dimensional optical data storage method that uses ultrafast interactions of polarized light with a 3D medium, mapping three controlled light parameters to three distinct material responses to suppress crosstalk and achieve 99.
summaries.zh: 论文提出了一种高保真六维光学数据存储方案，通过偏振光与三维介质的超快相互作用，将三个可控光参量一一对应到三种不同的材料响应以抑制串扰，从而获得99.

title: Seamless Gradient Pixels for Multidimensional Optical Information Interrogation
abstract: Information from light interaction with its environment can be extracted from its numerous properties. Yet capturing and interpreting this information within a single and compact platform remains challenging because conventional systems rely on discrete components and detection channels. Here we introduce the concept of "gradient pixels" that provides a universal metasurface platform to interrogate optical field information in the infrared (IR) spectrum. By continuously varying a design parameter across two dimensions, we encode multidimensional optical information into measurable spatial patterns, e.g., both spectral and polarization information are acquired from a single snapshot image. A free-form gradient pixel further enables prescribed wavelength-selective spatial patterns within a single metasurface through tailored gradient profiles. Unlike isolated filter arrays, seamless gradient-pixels multiplex neighbouring meta-atoms, increasing channel spatial density and relaxing Q-factor constraints. A 250-$\mu$m footprint of these meta-atoms achieves spectral resolution better than 100-pm over a 100-nm spectral span based on a serpentine configuration. Snapshot wavelength-polarization reconstruction yields polarization angular accuracy at 0.3$^\circ$. We extend this concept to perform near-field refractive index sensing at video rates using the same explicit parameter-space mapping. By linking far-field detection and near-field sensing, it enables spatially resolved analysis of optical fields and local dielectric environments through a common image-based readout. It offers prospects for multidimensional optical sensing, computational imaging and intelligent information processing.

summaries.en: The paper introduces “gradient pixels,” a universal gradient metasurface that continuously encodes multidimensional infrared optical information into single-shot spatial patterns for simultaneous spectral/polarization interrogation, wavelength-selective imaging, and fast near-field refractive-index sensing using a unified image-based readout.
summaries.zh: 论文提出“梯度像素（gradient pixels）”，一种通用的梯度超表面，通过在红外连续变化设计参数把多维光学信息编码为单次快照的空间图样，从而实现光谱/偏振的同步测量、单片可选波长的成像以及基于同一图像读出的视频级近场折射率传感，并将远场检测与近场感知统一起来。

title: Real-Time Single-Pixel Imaging via Exploiting Temporal Mixing: A Unified Calibration and Composite Readout Framework
abstract: In high-speed optical measurements and computational imaging such as in single-pixel imaging temporal mixing arising from the mismatch between modulation and the electro-optical acquisition chain is conventionally treated as an unmitigated distortion that corrupts measurement orthogonality, breaks compressive sensing priors, fundamentally limits imaging speed, and induces catastrophic reconstruction failure. Here, we establish a transferable, unified calibration and composite-readout framework for single-pixel imaging that systematically repurposes temporal memory from a readout limitation into a powerful measurement resource. Beyond achieving robust high-fidelity recovery, this engineered approach enables cost effective, lower bandwidth configurations to consistently deliver superior image quality compared to higher bandwidth reference setups across diverse operating conditions turning a historical hardware bottleneck into an active imaging advantage. Specifically, target scenes are reconstructed directly from mixed observations without the need to recover individual pattern projections, thereby significantly advancing high-speed and video-rate single-pixel imaging capabilities. Crucially, the transferability of our framework allows calibration routines established on one hardware platform (such as digital micromirror device-based setups) to be readily transferred across different optical systems (such as rotating coding disks), paving the way for calibrated temporal memory as a versatile and generalized measurement paradigm for broader computational imaging.

summaries.en: The paper presents a unified calibration and composite-readout framework for single-pixel imaging that converts temporally mixed, hardware-induced distortions into a usable measurement resource, enabling robust, high-fidelity, direct reconstruction from mixed observations with transferable calibration across optical platforms for faster, lower-bandwidth, video-rate imaging.
summaries.zh: 论文提出一种用于单像素成像的统一标定与复合读出框架，将由硬件引起的时间混叠（失配）从“破坏性失真”转化为可利用的测量资源，使得可直接从混合观测中进行鲁棒且高保真的重建，并实现跨不同光学系统的标定可迁移，从而在更低带宽配置下也能获得优于高带宽参考方案的高速、视频级成像能力。

title: Probing thin films and their interfaces via angle-resolved second-harmonic generation
abstract: Increasing demands on the performance and reliability of optical thin films stimulate the development of more sensitive characterisation methods capable of investigating thin-film interfaces or local mechanical stress. Second-harmonic generation (SHG) is a phenomenon that can serve as a non-destructive probe, tracing local symmetry changes in the film surface, bulk, and buried interfaces. Here, we investigate the decomposition of the SHG response from these three regions by combining angle- and polarisation-resolved measurements. We utilised a theoretical model of SHG accounting for multiple reflections and optical interference in a thin layer. The theory was first experimentally evaluated using Ta2O5 films deposited on different glass substrates. The fitting procedure accurately reproduced the measured SHG responses, revealing pronounced substrate-dependent variations in the buried-interface contribution, while the surface and effective-bulk responses remained similar. As the next step, we studied the reliability of the SHG signal decomposition into the surface, bulk and buried-interface components. The decomposition was evaluated by generating synthetic datasets and testing whether their retrieval was unique and accurate. The influence of film thickness, measurement noise, uncertainties in linear-optical parameters, and the polarisation channels used on the retrieval of nonlinear susceptibilities was also examined. Our results demonstrate that reliable separation of SHG contributions requires accurate linear optical parameters, global fitting of multiple polarisation channels, and sufficiently pronounced interference features, outlining the capabilities and practical limitations of SHG-based region-specific characterisation of optical thin films.

summaries.en: The paper presents and validates an angle- and polarization-resolved second-harmonic generation (SHG) method with a thin-film interference model to decompose SHG contributions from film surface, effective bulk, and buried interfaces, and assesses the conditions under which this separation is uniquely and reliably retrievable using experiments and synthetic data.
summaries.zh: 论文提出并验证了一种基于角度与偏振分辨的二次谐波（SHG）方法，结合薄膜干涉的理论模型以分离来自薄膜表面、等效体与埋藏界面的SHG贡献，并通过实验与合成数据评估在何种条件下这种分离能够被唯一且可靠地检索。

title: Sign-Controlled BIC Merging and Flatband Formation in C2-symmetric Photonic Lattices
abstract: Bound states in the continuum (BICs) on flatbands promise long-lived, weakly dispersive photons, yet their interplay remains elusive. Here, we develop a four-mode non-Hermitian Hamiltonian for $C_2$-symmetric photonic-crystal slabs. We show that the sign of the interpair coupling determines whether two Friedrich-Wintgen (FW) BICs and a symmetry-protected (SP) BIC occupy the same photonic band, a necessary condition for merging. In rectangular lattices, merging eliminates the quadratic radiative-loss term in a perfect-square form and strongly suppresses the quartic contribution, giving an effective $Q \sim k^{-6}$ scaling. Deviations from rectangular geometry induce noncollinear radiation polarizations, converting FW-BICs into quasi-BICs with $Q_{\mathrm{qBIC}} \sim (90^\circ-\theta)^{-2}$ and restoring the asymptotic $Q \sim k^{-2}$ scaling. Unlike BIC band selection, quadratic band flattening is insensitive to the coupling sign and can occur without BIC merging, even in oblique lattices. Our results reveal distinct conditions governing BIC merging, higher-order radiation suppression, and band flattening.

summaries.en: The paper proposes a four-mode non-Hermitian model for C2-symmetric photonic lattices showing that the sign of interpair coupling controls whether two Friedrich–Wintgen BICs and a symmetry-protected BIC share the same band to enable BIC merging, which in rectangular lattices yields strong higher-order radiation-loss suppression with effective Q∼k−6 scaling but reverts to quasi-BIC behavior and Q∼k−2 scaling when geometry-induced noncollinear polarizations break the ideal conditions, while band flattening can occur independently of BIC merging and coupling sign even in oblique lattices.
summaries.zh: 本文建立了一个C2对称光子晶格的四模非厄米哈密顿量模型，指出互对偶耦合的符号决定两个Friedrich–Wintgen（FW）BIC与一个对称保护（SP）BIC是否占据同一光子能带从而实现BIC合并；在矩形晶格中合并可消除二次辐射损耗并抑制更高阶项，使有效品质因数呈Q∼k−6标度，而偏离矩形导致非共线辐射极化将FW-BIC转化为准BIC并恢复渐近Q∼k−2标度；同时作者还发现能带展平可不依赖BIC合并与耦合符号，甚至在斜方晶格中也可发生。

title: Photonic processors that carry their own unclonable fingerprint
abstract: Physically unclonable functions (PUFs) derive cryptographic keys from uncontrollable fabrication disorder, removing the need to store secrets in vulnerable non-volatile memory. Programmable photonic processors are natural candidates for PUFs, because each of their many tunable interferometers carries its own fabrication imperfections. However, we show that the mesh topology itself funnels light along short paths, so that most of this disorder contributes little to the response. Here we introduce an isotropic ring routing scheme that steers light to the core of a hexagonal mesh and redistributes it uniformly towards the perimeter, suppressing a distance-dependent power decay of 14.7 dB and raising the mean Shannon entropy of the response from 1.95 to 3.48 bits by reprogramming alone. Experiments on two independently fabricated 72-unit silicon processors show that a nominally identical device cannot reproduce the target's responses even after its passive phase profile is fully compensated. Combining isotropic routing with spectral readout yields 1107 bits per challenge, exceeding previous results by two orders of magnitude, with 49.8% inter-challenge and 50.0% inter-chip Hamming distances and a 4.9% intra-chip distance. These results establish general-purpose programmable photonic processors as reconfigurable, high-capacity hardware roots of trust.

summaries.en: The paper proposes and experimentally validates an isotropic ring routing and spectral readout approach for programmable photonic processors that significantly improves PUF response entropy and inter-device distinctness, enabling high-capacity, reconfigurable hardware roots of trust based on fabrication-induced imperfections that cannot be cloned.
summaries.zh: 论文提出并通过实验验证了用于可编程光子处理器的各向同性环形路由与光谱读出方法，可显著提升PUF响应熵以及器件间差异性，从而利用不可克隆的工艺缺陷实现高容量、可重构的硬件可信根。

title: High-Speed Widefield Hyperspectral Imaging
abstract: Fourier-transform hyperspectral imaging is an emerging technology that combines widefield acquisition with flexible spectral resolution. Yet, it typically requires the acquisition of dense sequences of full-field interferograms during optical-path scanning, which ultimately reduces the final throughput. To circumvent this limitation, this manuscript introduces an event-based Fourier-transform hyperspectral microscopy technique that exploits the coupling of a neuromorphic event camera with a common-path birefringent interferometer operated under continuous scanning. Specifically, two complementary acquisition strategies are investigated, one with steady broadband illumination where the event stream corresponds to a derivative-like interferogram, and another with a temporal modulation of a broadband LED, which produces an intensity-like event response. Both approaches are able to retrieve the principal spectral profiles of photographic filters, showing a good qualitative match with both frame-based and spectrometer references. Compared against the typical 15-minute acquisition time for step-scan reference configuration, both methods represent a speedup larger than 3 orders of magnitude, entering real-time acquisition speeds: the derivative-based method acquires the useful interferometric range in approximately 200 ms, corresponding to an effective rate of approximately 5 hyperspectral cubes per second, whereas the modulation-assisted method achieves an experimentally measured spectral resolution of 17.9 nm at an effective acquisition rate of 2.5 datacubes per second. Finally, reflection-mode imaging and motion-compensated reconstruction of moving particles further demonstrate spatially resolved spectral recovery beyond static transmission measurements, establishing the solution as a promising technology for continuous, wide-field hyperspectral imaging.

summaries.en: The paper proposes an event-based Fourier-transform hyperspectral microscopy using a neuromorphic event camera with a continuously scanned common-path birefringent interferometer, employing either derivative-like or intensity-like event acquisition strategies to retrieve filter spectra while achieving real-time hyperspectral cube rates with major speedups over conventional step-scan methods.
summaries.zh: 论文提出了一种基于神经形态事件相机与连续扫描的共路径双折射干涉仪的事件驱动傅里叶变换高光谱显微成像方法，通过“导数型”或“强度型”两种事件采集策略获取滤光片的光谱轮廓，并相较传统步进扫描方案实现了大幅提速与接近实时的高光谱数据立方体采集速率，同时还展示了反射模式与运动补偿重建下的空间分辨光谱恢复能力。

title: DUV (257 nm) LIDT of Anti-Reflective Coatings
abstract: Laser-induced damage threshold in the deep ultraviolet (DUV) was used to perform tests on AR coated windows intended for industrial processes. The 257 nm wavelength was generated from Yb:YAG fundamental (1030 nm) and the long-term LIDT stability (up to 100000 shots) was selected as representative for minimal industrial qualification. Selected setup for the fourth harmonics generation consists of two stages, generation of second harmonic and subsequently the fourth harmonic with 13,4% conversation efficiency. In both 1-on-1 and S-on-1 experiments, the optics coated with Al2O3/SiO2 by ion beam sputtering technique demonstrated the highest LIDT value of 0.73 and 0.5 J/cm2 respectively. Various damage morphologies, color centers, ballistic damage, delamination, and blistering were observed across the samples with respect to the 1-on-1 and S-on-1.

summaries.en: The study measured 257 nm laser-induced damage thresholds of ion-beam-sputtered Al2O3/SiO2 anti-reflective coatings on windows for industrial use using a two-stage harmonic-generation setup from 1030 nm Yb:YAG, finding peak LIDT values of 0.
summaries.zh: 该研究在从1030 nm 的 Yb:YAG 激光经两级谐波产生得到257 nm 的条件下，测试了用于工业过程的离子束溅射沉积 Al2O3/SiO2 抗反射涂层窗口的激光诱导损伤阈值，选择了最高可达10万次脉冲的长期LIDT稳定性作为代表性指标，结果在1-on-1与S-on-1实验中最高LIDT分别为0.

title: Hybrid Plasmon-Phonon Eigenmodes and Vortex States in a Graphene Ring on a Silica Substrate
abstract: We investigate hybrid plasmon-phonon eigenmodes and localized electromagnetic vortex states in a graphene ring supported by a dispersive silica substrate. The interaction between graphene plasmons and infrared-active optical phonons of the substrate gives rise to distinct spectral branches of surface polaritons, whose dispersion characteristics are established analytically and validated by full-wave numerical simulations. Geometric confinement of these hybrid surface excitations produces spectrally separated families of localized multipolar eigenmodes with corresponding azimuthal symmetries. Particular attention is devoted to quadrupolar eigenstates, which exhibit nearly identical normalized spatial field distributions despite their substantial spectral separation and different attenuation characteristics. We demonstrate that coherent superposition of orthogonal quadrupolar field patterns gives rise to localized vortex states with opposite azimuthal phase winding. The preservation of the spatial eigenmode structure across distinct spectral branches is consistent with a quasistatic description in which the resonator geometry governs the modal symmetry, whereas the dispersive material response determines the spectral properties. These findings reveal a route toward controlling structured electromagnetic near fields through plasmon--phonon hybridization and establish a physical basis for multiband vortex states in deeply subwavelength graphene resonators.

summaries.en: The paper analyzes a graphene ring on a dispersive silica substrate where graphene plasmon–phonon coupling creates multiple surface-polariton spectral branches with geometry-determined localized multipolar eigenmodes, including quadrupoles whose coherent superposition yields localized electromagnetic vortex states with opposite phase winding.
summaries.zh: 论文研究了石英二氧化硅分散基底上的石墨烯环，石墨烯等离激元与基底红外活性光学声子耦合会形成多条表面极化激元谱分支，并在几何约束下产生由对称性主导的局域多极本征模（尤其是尽管谱位置差异很大但归一化空间场分布几乎相同的四极模），其正交四极场的相干叠加可实现具有相反方位相位缠绕的局域涡旋态，表明在深亚波长石墨烯共振器中可借助等离激元—声子杂化来控制结构化近场并实现多带涡旋态。

title: High-Power Short-Wavelength Frequency Comb from Coherent Radiation of Uncompressed Electron Beams
abstract: High-power frequency combs at short wavelengths would open new opportunities for precision measurements and high-resolution spectroscopy. Here, we propose a frequency comb based on coherent undulator radiation from uncompressed electron bunches. An optical frequency comb serves as the seed, establishing a common phase reference for microbunching in successive electron bunches and transferring its phase coherence to short-wavelength harmonic radiation. By exploiting interference between distinct laser-induced microbunching pathways, we reduce the sensitivity of the harmonic bunching phase to electron-beam energy fluctuations, a major challenge for maintaining interpulse coherence. Start-to-end simulations demonstrate frequency comb generation in the vacuum-ultraviolet (148 nm) and soft X-ray regimes, yielding average radiation powers of approximately 1 W and 100 mW, respectively, with approximately 6 $\mu$W and 100 nW concentrated in individual comb teeth. These results establish a promising route toward high-power, phase-coherent short-wavelength frequency combs for precision spectroscopy, including searches for the nuclear transition in trapped $^{229}$Th ions.

summaries.en: The paper proposes a high-power short-wavelength optical frequency comb generated from coherent undulator radiation of uncompressed electron bunches, using an optical seed to phase-lock successive microbunching pathways and interference to suppress sensitivity to energy fluctuations, with simulations predicting ~1 W at 148 nm and ~100 mW in soft X rays in addition to phase-coherent power per comb tooth for precision spectroscopy such as trapped 229Th nuclear-transition searches.
summaries.zh: 本文提出利用未压缩电子束在插入器中产生相干辐射来实现高功率短波长频率梳：通过光学种子为连续电子束的微束缚提供共同相位参考，并利用不同激光诱导微束缚路径之间的干涉来降低辐射微束缚相位对能量涨落的敏感性这一维持梳间相干的关键挑战；端到端仿真表明可在真空紫外148 nm与软X射线区生成频率梳，平均辐射功率约1 W与100 mW，单个梳齿上约6 μW与100 nW相干功率，从而为精密光谱（如受陷229Th离子的核跃迁搜索）提供有前景的相干短波长高功率频率梳方案。

title: A photon-number-conserving multimode framework for pulse propagation dynamics across zero nonlinearity: Kerr-Raman cooperation and competition
abstract: Raman scattering in multimode fibers shifts pulse spectra to lower frequencies and transfers photons between spatial modes. When the nonlinear coefficient changes sign within the pulse spectrum, the ordinary generalized nonlinear Schrödinger equation (GNLSE) can give unphysical predictions. Existing photon-number-conserving formulations either treat a single mode or exclude Raman scattering. We develop a time-domain multimode GNLSE that conserves photon number, includes the full Raman response and remains well defined at the zero-nonlinearity frequency. For narrowband pulses with a constant positive nonlinear coefficient, the framework reduces to the standard multimode GNLSE with instantaneous Kerr and delayed Raman terms. We then apply the framework to three coherently excited modes whose spectra shift across the zero-nonlinearity frequency. The Kerr and Raman processes first cooperate and then compete. In the first stage, both processes transfer photons into the fundamental mode, contributing about 2\% and 43\% of the initial total photon number. In the second stage, Kerr transfer drives photons out of the fundamental mode, while Raman transfer drives photons back, contributing about $-27\%$ and $+15\%$, respectively. Consequently, the fundamental-mode photon fraction rises from 20\% to 65\% and then falls to 53\%. Kerr terms that leave the modal photon populations unchanged still reshape the fields and thereby enhance Raman transfer. Moreover, changing only the relative input phases can reverse the initial Raman-driven flow into the fundamental mode, even for identical modal spectra. Taken together, the results show how instantaneous and delayed nonlinear responses, together with intermodal phase, govern photon redistribution across zero nonlinearity.

summaries.en: The paper presents a photon-number-conserving time-domain multimode generalized nonlinear Schrödinger framework that fully includes Kerr and delayed Raman effects and stays well defined when the nonlinearity changes sign across a pulse spectrum, showing for three phase-coherent modes that Kerr and Raman first cooperate and then compete to redistribute photons among modes with strong dependence on relative input phases.
summaries.zh: 本文提出一种守恒光子数的时域多模广义非线性薛定谔框架，完整包含瞬时Kerr与延迟Raman效应，并在脉冲谱跨越非线性过零点时依然适定；通过相干激发的三模计算表明，Kerr与Raman先协同后竞争，驱动不同模间光子重分配且结果对输入模间相对相位高度敏感。

title: From power to spectrum: an off-the-shelf photodiode turned into a spectrometer by its bias alone
abstract: Computational spectrometers replace dispersive optics with detectors whose spectral response can be varied, but every reported single-detector device obtains this response through dedicated fabrication: two-dimensional heterostructures, graded epitaxial junctions, organic stacks, filters or photonic circuits. We demonstrate a generic, fabrication-free alternative in which a standard commercial photodiode becomes a spectrometer through its electrical drive alone, requiring no modification of the device, no optical filter and no modulation of the light. The mechanism is bias-modulated optoelectronic chromatic dispersion (OED): light of different wavelengths is absorbed at different depths, and a sinusoidal bias changes how carriers generated at each depth are collected, so that every spectrum is encoded in the shape of the photocurrent waveform over one bias period. Applied to an unmodified InGaAs PIN photodiode at room temperature, a 10 us waveform decoded by a neural network reconstructs spectra of one to three laser lines across the 80 nm of the telecom C+L band, locating the lines to 0.3-0.4 nm, counting them in about 99% of measurements and identifying their power levels, with line shifts tracked to tens of picometres. Because OED relies on universal semiconductor transport physics, the approach is material-agnostic and applies in principle to any off-the-shelf photodiode, turning detectors already deployed as power monitors into low-cost spectral sensors.
subjects: Optics (physics.optics) ; Image and Video Processing (eess.IV); Signal Processing (eess.SP); Systems and Control (eess.SY)

summaries.en: The paper shows that a standard commercial photodiode can be turned into a computational spectrometer using only its bias, leveraging bias-modulated optoelectronic chromatic dispersion so that a single photocurrent waveform encodes spectra and a neural network decodes laser line positions and powers across the telecom C+L band without device modification, optical filtering, or light modulation.
summaries.zh: 论文表明，只需对标准商用光电二极管施加偏置即可把它变成计算光谱仪，利用偏置调制的光电色散机制使单次光电流波形编码光谱，并由神经网络解码得到电信C+L带内多条激光线的位置与功率，同时无需器件改造、光学滤波或光的调制。

title: Colloquium: Isotopes for medicine and fundamental physics
abstract: Isotopes, variants of elements distinguished by their neutron number, have important applications for medicine and fundamental science. This review explores the historical challenges and new technologies for enriching and detecting isotopes. We motivate the work by challenges posed by three of history's greatest scientists: James Clerk Maxwell's thought experiment on thermodynamics, Ernest Rutherford's practical dilemma in radiochemistry, and Albert Einstein's questions about the probabilistic nature of quantum mechanics. The journey to meet these challenges has catalyzed the development of innovative techniques for isotope separation. These advancements can mitigate the worldwide crisis in the supply of enriched isotopes. We then explore the expected impact of these new technologies on medicine, which include radioisotopes for cancer therapy and stable isotopes as tracers for metabolism. We explain the importance of developing scalable techniques for isotope detection and how it can help with early detection of certain diseases. Finally, we turn to basic science, outlining proposed new tests of quantum mechanics that utilize radioactive atomic clocks to probe the fundamental nature of determinism and distinguishability of atoms.
subjects: Applied Physics (physics.app-ph) ; Atomic Physics (physics.atom-ph); History and Philosophy of Physics (physics.hist-ph); Medical Physics (physics.med-ph); Quantum Physics (quant-ph)

summaries.en: The review discusses historical challenges and emerging technologies for enriching and detecting isotopes, linking them to seminal questions from Maxwell, Rutherford, and Einstein, and highlights how scalable isotope supply and detection can improve medical applications and enable new quantum-mechanics tests using radioactive atomic clocks.
summaries.zh: 该综述回顾了同位素（由中子数区分）在富集与探测方面的历史难题与新技术进展，并以麦克斯韦、卢瑟福和爱因斯坦的思想与问题为线索，说明同位素供给与可扩展探测能力如何推动医疗应用，同时也可能借助放射性原子钟开展新的量子力学检验以揭示决定论与原子可辨性等基础问题。

title: Geometric control of diffusive relaxation: spectral design, transport bounds and transverse mode isolation
abstract: Geometric confinement changes both thermal relaxation and heat throughput, but these effects need not be governed by the same conduction path. We establish a distinction between serial and parallel geometries for passive, homogeneous Fourier conductors at fixed material properties, volume and length. For a reduced variable-area conductor, two logarithmic shape harmonics independently tune two selected Bloch-rate pairs, and exact local transport level sets permit spectral redistribution at fixed effective diffusivity. A nonperturbative weighted Poincaré bound, however, requires the effective axial diffusivity to vanish if the first positive insulated rate tends to zero at fixed length. This obstruction is avoided by continuous parallel paths with weak transverse exchange. Capacity-weighted networks identify the exchange mechanism, and a three-dimensional product domain provides an exact bulk realization. Its axial conductance remains $\kappa V/L^2$, while exactly one positive insulated rate vanishes and the next approaches a positive limit set by axial, chamber and neck diffusion. The slow rate is asymptotically the transverse neck conductance times the sum of inverse chamber capacities. Spectral projection estimates translate this separation into a preparation- and readout-dependent observation window. The result is metastable retention of a temperature contrast under insulated conditions, not a second equilibrium state. It identifies when geometrical control of internal equilibration can be separated from macroscopic heat transport.
subjects: Applied Physics (physics.app-ph) ; Statistical Mechanics (cond-mat.stat-mech); Mathematical Physics (math-ph)

summaries.en: The paper uses geometric design of diffusive Fourier conductors to independently control thermal relaxation spectra and axial heat transport, proving when spectral redistribution is possible, when a weighted Poincaré bound forces effective axial diffusivity to vanish, and how weakly coupled parallel paths with quantified transverse exchange yield metastable temperature-contrast retention without a new equilibrium state, linking these separations to observation windows relevant for quantum-optics/quantum-computing contexts.
summaries.zh: 论文通过几何设计扩散型傅里叶导体，证明可在不改变材料性质、体积与长度的前提下独立调控热弛豫谱与轴向热输运，并给出谱重分配何时可行、以及加权庞加莱界何时会迫使有效轴向扩散系数在首个正的绝热弛豫率趋零时消失；同时作者构造了弱横向交换的连续并联通道，借助容量加权网络识别交换机制并用三维乘积域实现精确体相例子，从而实现绝热条件下的亚稳温差保持而非新的平衡态，并将这种分离转化为与制备/读出相关的可观测时间窗。

title: Exceptional unidirectional radiation modes
abstract: Singularities such as exceptional points (EPs) and bound states in the continuum (BICs) fundamentally reshape the spectral response of non-Hermitian open systems, unlocking exotic physical phenomena and unprecedented ways of wave manipulation. Nevertheless, the radiation behaviors of modes evolving around these singularities lack a unified picture. Here we show that a mode originating from a BIC can radiate unidirectionally, exhibiting a quality factor that continuously varies in parameter space from a near-infinite value (near the BIC) to a finite lower bound as it coalesces with the other (leaky) mode at an EP. The crossing of the unidirectional radiation mode and the EP in parameter space results in not only merged poles (resonant EP) but also merged zeros (absorbing EP) of the scattering matrix, along with a counterintuitive reversal of radiation direction decoupled from the coalesced eigenmodes under near-field excitation. These phenomena are experimentally observed in an acoustic waveguide system featuring two side-branch resonant cavities with deliberate frequency detuning and asymmetric dissipation. Our findings reveal the intrinsic connection between eigenmode topology and radiation behavior in open systems, offering a viable route for tailoring scattering and radiation responses via non-Hermitian modulations.

summaries.en: The paper demonstrates experimentally and theoretically how a mode emerging from a bound state in the continuum can evolve into a unidirectionally radiating mode whose quality factor smoothly decreases from near-infinite near the BIC to a finite bound at an exceptional point, producing merged poles and zeros of the scattering matrix and even a radiation-direction reversal under near-field excitation that is decoupled from the coalesced eigenmodes in an acoustic waveguide system with non-Hermitian modulation.
summaries.zh: 本文在非厄米调控的声学波导体系中实验与理论表明：从连续谱束缚态（BIC）出发的模态可演化为单向辐射模，其品质因数在参数空间中从BIC附近的近乎无穷连续下降到与另一（漏）模在异常点（EP）处合并时的有限下限，同时会在散射矩阵中出现极点与零点的合并，并在近场激发下实现与特征模合并解耦的辐射方向反转；这些结果揭示了开放系统中本征模拓扑与辐射行为之间的内在联系，为定制散射与辐射响应提供了可行途径。

title: Passive memories beyond the Ising model: from SFQ to GKP
abstract: Self-correcting quantum memories are spin Hamiltonians that aim to generalize the classical memory of the magnetic hard disk (i.e. ferromagnetic Ising model) to protect against both bit flips and phase flips. Beyond the magnetic hard disk, there are other passive classical memories that are used in modern computers, notably: the flash memory in laptops (which traps charge on a conducting island), and the flux storage loop in single-flux quantum (SFQ) logic (which traps flux in a superconducting loop). In this paper we review how storage and writing work in these two classical memories, drawing analogies to the charge qubit and the flux qubit. Protection in these systems derives not from scaling a lattice to the thermodynamic limit, but from a large, tunable energy barrier that separates codewords during memory, yet can be suppressed during a write. Towards protecting a qubit: We introduce a 2D ``floating XY model'' that combines the exponential (phase-flip) protection of the floating charge island with the polynomial (bit-flip) protection of the ferromagnetic XY model. We also study a self-dual superconducting circuit that hosts GKP codewords as symmetry-broken ground states of a $\mathbb{Z}_2 \times \mathbb{Z}_2 $-symmetric circuit, and discuss its protection and limitations.
subjects: Quantum Physics (quant-ph) ; Mesoscale and Nanoscale Physics (cond-mat.mes-hall); Strongly Correlated Electrons (cond-mat.str-el)

summaries.en: The paper reviews passive classical-memory mechanisms in flash and SFQ flux loops, draws analogies to charge and flux qubits, and proposes/analyses beyond-Ising self-correcting ideas including a 2D floating XY model for combined phase/bit protection and a self-dual superconducting circuit whose ground states realize GKP codewords, emphasizing protection via large energy barriers rather than thermodynamic scaling and outlining benefits and limits.
summaries.zh: 本文回顾了笔记本闪存与单磁通量子（SFQ）逻辑中超导储能回路这两类无源经典存储的写入与存储机理，类比为电荷与磁通量子比特，并提出/研究超越 Ising 的自纠错思路：包括结合浮置电荷岛的指数型（相位翻转）保护与铁磁 XY 模型的多项式（比特翻转）保护的二维“浮置 XY 模型”，以及一个自对偶超导电路，其在   对称电路的   对称破缺基态中承载 GKP 码字，重点讨论依赖可调大能垒而非热力学极限缩放的保护机制及其局限。

title: A Basis-Dependent Kernel for Learning Quantum Phases of Matter
abstract: Identifying the phases of a quantum many-body system as its parameters vary is a central problem in condensed-matter physics. Data-driven approaches address this task by comparing quantum states, for instance through their fidelity, and locating transitions where these comparisons change abruptly. In this work, we introduce the inverse participation ratio (IPR) kernel, a kernel method built for learning quantum phases of matter from IPRs in physically motivated bases. Unlike fidelity-based kernels, the IPR kernel can identify states with physically meaningful similarity even when they are orthogonal. We test the method on ground states of the transverse-field Ising (TFIM) and Heisenberg XXZ models. For TFIM Gibbs states, we further show that the IPR kernel retains phase-relevant structure over a range of nonzero temperatures where the phase signal of fidelity-based kernels is already degraded. More broadly, our results suggest that quantum kernels benefit more from feature maps tailored to the physics of the problem than from maximal expressivity.

summaries.en: The paper proposes an inverse-participation-ratio (IPR) kernel that learns quantum phases from IPRs in physically motivated bases, enabling physically meaningful similarity detection even for orthogonal states and demonstrating improved phase learning on TFIM and Heisenberg XXZ ground states, including robustness at finite temperatures where fidelity-based kernels degrade.
summaries.zh: 本文提出一种基于逆参与比（IPR）的核方法，通过在物理上有意义的基底中从IPR学习量子相，即使对正交态也能识别具有物理可解释性的相似性，并在横场伊辛（TFIM）与Heisenberg XXZ模型的基态上验证其相识别效果，还表明其在有限非零温度区间内能保持相结构而此时基于保真度的核信号已衰减，结果提示量子核更应依赖贴合问题物理的特征映射而非仅追求最大表达能力。

title: Modeling couplings and quench dynamics of hundred-qubit quantum processors
abstract: Quantum processors now operate beyond the reach of exact classical simulation, yet their design and verification rest on precise models of the device. Understanding which properties of quantum processors can still be predicted on classical computers is central both to building these machines and to delimiting claims of quantum advantage. Here we address this question at the device level, using continuous unitary transformations to derive effective Hamiltonians non-perturbatively for two-dimensional superconducting processors at a cost polynomial in qubit number. For a 96-transmon array with tunable couplers, we extract the effective qubit couplings, state-dependent interactions (e.g., ZZ couplings), and eigenstate locality that guide processor design. This computation parallelizes over tensor contractions and thus takes an hour at most per design point on a single GPU, enabling rapid design iterations of the full array. Combining these effective models with semiclassical sampling, we then predict the quench dynamics of 100 qubits and 180 couplers at half filling, a sector of dimension $10^{29}$, and validate the approach against exact dynamics of smaller arrays. We show that our approach captures relaxation, thermalization, and transport, but not the bitstring statistics underlying cross-entropy benchmarks. The predicted transport carries a fingerprint of the device: under a staggered detuning, excitations cross over from ballistic to diffusive spreading, slow down at a doublon resonance, and diffuse at different rates on each sublattice. Our results chart which observables lie within classical reach and offer a practical tool for designing future devices.
