summaries.zh: 本文提出一种基于连续幺正变换的非微扰、且随量子比特数多项式增长的GPU计算方法，用于为大型超导量子阵列推导等效哈密顿量，从而实现快速器件设计迭代并在经典层面预测100量子比特的猝发动力学，同时明确哪些观测量仍在经典可计算范围内、哪些（如与交叉熵基准相关的比特串统计）则不可及。

title: Self-testing in Fermionic Networks
abstract: Self-testing certifies quantum states and measurements from observed correlations alone, without assumptions on the inner workings of the devices. Its standard formulation, however, models the devices as manipulating qudits, of arbitrary or even infinite dimension. Yet febits, information encoded in the presence or absence of a fermion in a mode, can produce correlations in quantum networks that no qudit model reproduces under the same locality constraints. We first show that the modeling choice in terms of qudits or febits matters for self-testing: some correlations that self-test a unique qudit strategy admit two fermionic realizations inequivalent under local parity-preserving isometries. We then develop a fermionic self-testing framework and show that the correlations of a three-party rewiring network single out febit states and measurements up to such isometries, providing the first genuine fermionic self-test.

summaries.en: The paper shows that self-testing results depend on whether devices are modeled as qudits or fermionic febits, proving that some correlations have multiple inequivalent fermionic realizations, and then develops a fermionic self-testing framework that, via a three-party rewiring network, uniquely certifies febit states and measurements up to local parity-preserving isometries, yielding the first true fermionic self-test.
summaries.zh: 本文表明，自检（self-testing）的结论取决于将设备建模为量子比特维（qudit）还是费米子比特（febit）；作者证明某些能唯一确定量子维策略的相关在费米实现下可能出现两种在局部保奇偶同构下不等价的实现，并进一步提出一种费米子自检框架，通过三方重连（rewiring）网络的相关，在局部保奇偶同构意义下唯一刻画febit态与测量，从而给出首个真正的费米子自检。

title: A measurement-free quantum error correction protocol for superconducting cavities
abstract: The realization of large-scale quantum computation will require quantum error correction (QEC). One way to reduce the demands placed on QEC is to correct dominant physical errors at a lower level before passing the remaining errors to an outer code. Recently, Krastanov et al. [Nat. Commun. 12, 191 (2021)] proposed a measurement-free error-correction protocol based on coherent control of photonic modes that corrects for photon loss. Here, we adapt this approach to a circuit quantum electrodynamics (cQED) architecture using three superconducting microwave cavities coupled by Josephson-junction-based nonlinear elements. We encode the logical qubit in the lowest-order binomial code of one cavity, while the two other cavities serve as ancillas. Using numerical simulations with experimentally realistic parameters, we demonstrate that our protocol can correct single-photon loss with 99% fidelity. Furthermore, we optimize the waiting time between successive rounds of error-correction, and show that the logical lifetime can be extended by a factor of 1.2-1.8 relative to the unprotected Fock $\{|0\rangle, |1\rangle\}$ encoding, surpassing break-even performance. Our work highlights the potential of gate-based, measurement-free QEC for fault-tolerant quantum computing.

summaries.en: The paper presents a measurement-free quantum error correction protocol for a cQED system using three superconducting cavities and nonlinear couplers to implement the binomial code, showing via realistic numerical simulations that it can correct single-photon loss with 99% fidelity and extend logical lifetimes by 1.
summaries.zh: 论文提出了一种适用于cQED体系的无测量量子纠错方案，利用三个超导腔与非线性耦合器实现二项式码；基于具实验可实现参数的数值模拟，结果表明该方案能以99%的保真度纠正单光子损失，并将逻辑寿命相对未受保护的|0⟩、|1⟩费克编码延长1.

title: Characterizing a neutral atom quantum simulator accessible in cloud
abstract: Quantum simulators have become a reality in recent years, with several platforms now remotely accessible through the cloud. These systems give researchers the opportunity to run quantum programs without requiring either a dedicated laboratory or extensive experimental expertise, and, in several cases, they have already enabled the execution of relevant protocols with remarkable results. However, despite the impressive progress in the performance of these machines, they still suffer from various noise sources, some of which are not always completely clear to the end user, which limits their applicability to tasks that are sufficiently robust against noise of various kinds. In this work, we investigate the behavior of Fresnel, a remotely accessible neutral-atom analog quantum simulator provided by Pasqal. We design and perform a series of experiments probing the machine's response to various pulse sequences and experimental settings, and identify the main noise sources affecting its dynamics. Based on these data, we construct an effective model of the system's noisy evolution and use numerical optimization to infer the noise strengths. The resulting model accurately reproduces the simulator's dynamics, showing how effective noise models can be built for cloud-based quantum resources.

summaries.en: The paper characterizes the noise and dynamical behavior of Fresnel, a cloud-accessible neutral-atom analog quantum simulator, by running pulse-sequence experiments, identifying dominant noise sources, and fitting an effective noisy-evolution model whose inferred parameters reproduce the observed dynamics.
summaries.zh: 论文通过对Pasqal的云端可访问中性原子模拟量子模拟器Fresnel进行脉冲序列实验，识别主要噪声来源，并据此构建与数值优化相结合的有效噪声演化模型，从而准确复现实验得到的动力学行为。

title: Interfacing Silicon Nitride Nanophotonics with Cuprous Oxide Rydberg Excitons
abstract: Rydberg excitons in cuprous oxide (Cu$_2$O), the solid-state counterpart of Rydberg atoms, are hydrogen-like electron--hole quasi-particles with micron-sized wavefunctions and strong long-range interactions that promise optical nonlinearities at the few-photon level. Exploiting them in a waveguide quantum electrodynamics (WQED) setting can enable what atomic Rydberg platforms achieve only with ultrahigh vacuum and laser cooling/trapping---a guided optical mode interfaced with the Rydberg medium---while adding the scalability and advanced fabrication of integrated photonics. Here we demonstrate a monolithic, CMOS-compatible interface of Cu$_2$O Rydberg excitons with a SiN$_x$ nanophotonic waveguide. Under non-resonant excitation, excitonic emission from the Cu$_2$O microcrystal is coupled to the guided mode, routed along the waveguide, and collected from an output grating. The spectrum shows the phonon-assisted 1$s$ orthoexciton emission together with the low-lying 2$p$ and 3$p$ lines of the yellow Rydberg series. Spatially selective excitation excludes substrate background and direct scatter, and the enhanced linear polarization of the grating-collected signal identifies the TE-like guided mode as the collection channel. These results establish the complete material--device--measurement stack for a novel platform of nonlinear quantum nanophotonics based on Rydberg excitons.

summaries.en: The paper demonstrates a monolithic CMOS-compatible interface where cuprous oxide Rydberg excitons are coupled to and collected from a SiNx nanophotonic waveguide under non-resonant excitation, revealing phonon-assisted 1s orthoexciton emission and yellow Rydberg series (2p, 3p) lines and identifying the TE-like guided mode via polarization-resolved grating collection to establish a full platform stack for nonlinear quantum nanophotonics.
summaries.zh: 论文展示了在SiNx纳米光子波导上实现单片式CMOS兼容耦合界面：在非共振激发下，氧化亚铜的Rydberg激子发射进入并沿波导传输、由输出光栅收集，光谱中观察到声子辅助的1s正激子以及黄色Rydberg系的2p与3p谱线，并通过偏振分辨光栅信号确认收集通道为类TE导模，从而建立基于Rydberg激子的非线性量子纳米光子学平台的完整材料-器件-测量体系。

title: Remote Use of Quantum Machines in the Adversarial Scenario
abstract: Networked quantum technologies allow users to operate quantum machines hosted by remote servers, but classical commands alone cannot ensure that only the intended user can prepare the useful inputs that activate them. We formulate the problem of adversarial remote use of quantum machines in the framework of quantum resource theories. A device controlled by Bob is correlated to a remote user, Alice, through a bipartite state, and also to an adversary Eve holding its purification. Alice and Eve compete to programme Bob's machine by remotely preparing its inputs: the conditional state carries the quantum resource, while the measurement outcome selects the machine operation. Remote use is truly advantageous when Alice is guaranteed to unlock a larger average task value than the adversary Eve, given the same marginal state of Bob. We show that for tasks with a convex figure of merit, the competition is governed by complementary upper roofs and, for spectral tasks, where the figure of merit is invariant under unitary operations, by a corresponding entanglement imbalance. Purification, work extraction, quantum batteries, and coherence distillation show that the same noisy state may secure exclusivity one machine but not another. Finally, we order Alice's and Eve's complete programming powers through a task-independent simulation preorder, based on the ensembles each party can prepare on Bob's side. Shared quantum correlations thereby become a key resource for controlling access to remote quantum machines.

summaries.en: The paper studies adversarial remote control of networked quantum machines using quantum resource theories, showing how shared quantum correlations determine whether an intended user can reliably outperform an adversary in programming tasks, with results characterized by complementary upper roofs for convex tasks and by entanglement imbalance for spectral tasks, and establishing a task-independent simulation order that compares each party’s programming power.
summaries.zh: 论文在量子资源理论框架下研究了对网络化量子机器的对抗式远程使用，表明共享量子关联如何决定预期用户在远程编程任务中能否稳定超过对手，并对不同类型任务分别给出刻画结果（凸型指标由互补的上包络决定、谱型指标由纠缠失衡决定），同时通过基于各方可在Bob侧制备的集合建立了与任务无关的模拟序来比较双方编程能力。

title: The computational complexity of bosonic Lindbladian fixed points
abstract: We study the computational complexity of estimating observables and sampling from stationary states, or fixed points, of bosonic Lindbladian dynamics with bounded-degree polynomial interactions. While the complexity of transient bosonic dynamics has been investigated, understanding the computational power of bosonic fixed points requires addressing subtleties of infinite-dimensional systems, including the existence, uniqueness, and convergence of stationary states. We establish a broad complexity landscape spanning universal quantum computation, efficient classical simulation, sampling hardness, and undecidability. First, we show that universal quantum computation can be embedded into observable estimation at the unique fixed point of a bosonic Lindbladian with a Hamiltonian of degree at most twelve and only linear photon loss. Moreover, this fixed point can be prepared from vacuum in polynomial time. On the classical side, we identify Gaussian regimes with incoherent pumping that admit efficient photon-number sampling and establish stability of classical approximability under sufficiently weak non-Gaussian Kerr perturbations. Conversely, for Gaussian fixed points without incoherent pumping, we establish hardness of exact sampling under constant-rate linear loss and hardness of approximate sampling at inverse-polynomial loss rates under standard boson-sampling conjectures. We also relate sampling from non-Gaussian fixed points to variants of boson sampling. Finally, we prove that deciding the existence of a stationary density operator is $\mathsf{RE}$-hard, even for purely dissipative Lindbladians with degree-five jump operators acting on at most four modes.

summaries.en: The paper maps the computational complexity of estimating observables and sampling bosonic Lindbladian stationary states, showing regimes that encode universal quantum computation, regimes admitting efficient classical Gaussian simulations, sampling hardness under certain losses, and even RE-hardness for deciding the existence of stationary density operators in small purely dissipative systems.
summaries.zh: 本文研究了估计玻色子Lindblad动力学稳态（固定点）观测量与进行采样的计算复杂性，给出同时包含可嵌入通用量子计算、可高效进行的高斯经典模拟、在特定损耗下的采样困难，以及在仅含纯耗散且少模态系统中仍对判断稳态密度算符存在性达到RE难度的整体复杂性图景。

title: Parallel transversal entangling gates for fault-tolerant trapped-ion quantum computing
abstract: Fault-tolerant quantum computing requires high-fidelity entangling gates that can be implemented efficiently across multiple qubit pairs. We present a scheme for simultaneous pairwise entangling operations, i.e., a transversal controlled-$Z$ gate, across neighboring wells in a double-well trapped-ion architecture. A tailored dynamical decoupling scheme suppresses unwanted couplings with a pulse count that scales quadratically with the number of ions. We show that incorporating a genuine geometric cancellation reduces the pulse count and, for selected register sizes, allows the parallel operation to be completed faster than an equivalent sequence of two-qubit gates while requiring a significantly smaller two-photon Rabi frequency. We assess the experimental feasibility of the protocol by analyzing the impact of decoherence and crosstalk arising from laser wave-vector misalignment. To gain insight into the robustness of fault-tolerant protocols against realistic imperfections of the proposed transversal gate scheme, we investigate how crosstalk-induced gate errors affect the fault-tolerant preparation of a logical Bell state between two $[[4,1,2]]$ quantum-error-detection code blocks. These results highlight the potential of transversal entangling gates as a building block for trapped-ion-based scalable fault-tolerant quantum error correction.

summaries.en: The paper proposes and analyzes a trapped-ion scheme for implementing parallel transversal controlled-Z entangling gates across neighboring double-well sites using tailored dynamical decoupling and geometric cancellation, reducing pulse requirements and improving scalability while assessing feasibility under decoherence, laser crosstalk, and fault-tolerant logical Bell-state preparation using [[4,1,2]] code blocks.
summaries.zh: 本文提出并评估一种在双阱囚禁离子体系中跨相邻位置并行实现横向受控-Z（transversal controlled-Z）纠缠门的方案：通过定制的动态解耦与真正的几何抵消来抑制非期望耦合并降低脉冲需求、从而提升可扩展性，同时在考虑相干退相干与激光波矢失配引起的串扰等因素下评估其实验可行性，并进一步研究串扰诱发的门错误对采用 [[4,1,2]] 量子纠错检测码块制备两码块逻辑贝尔态的容错性能影响，表明横向纠缠门有望成为囚禁离子可扩展容错量子纠错的构件。

title: Nonmagnetic Impurity Effects on Majorana Braiding Quantum Gates in Vortex Cores
abstract: Using time-dependent many-body simulations, we investigate nonmagnetic impurity effects on vortex-core Majorana braiding. In the two-MZM $\sqrt{Z}$ gate, sufficiently strong attractive impurities suppress the topological gap $\Delta_t$, reduce adiabaticity, and degrade the quantization of the geometric-phase difference; the repulsive impurities considered here cause no comparable damage despite stronger zero-energy nonequilibrium local density of states (LDOS) distortions. Slowing the braid or using a $2a_0$ detour restores near-quantization in the cases examined. In the four-MZM configuration, attractive impurities leave the low-energy spectrum nearly unchanged, whereas repulsive impurities mainly suppress the first excited state. Slower braiding substantially improves the $X$ gate success probability. A specific attractive-impurity pair yields near-unit success ($\approx 0.9985$), unlike two weak repulsive impurities. These findings clarify how nonmagnetic impurities affect the low-energy spectrum and adiabatic dynamics of vortex-core Majorana braiding and provide theoretical guidance for designing robust braiding protocols in realistic topological superconducting platforms.

summaries.en: Time-dependent many-body simulations show that nonmagnetic attractive impurities in vortex-core Majorana systems can suppress the topological gap and reduce adiabatic quantization in both two-MZM √Z and four-MZM X-gate braiding, while repulsive impurities are less harmful and slower braiding or specific detours restore near-ideal performance, enabling near-unit success for certain impurity configurations.
summaries.zh: 基于时变的多体仿真结果，研究表明涡旋核马约拉纳系统中的非磁性吸引型杂质会削弱拓扑能隙并降低两马约拉纳 √Z 与四马约拉纳 X 门编织过程中的绝热量子化效果，而排斥型杂质影响相对较小，且通过减慢编织或采用特定绕行可恢复接近理想的性能，并且在特定杂质配置下可实现约 0.

title: High-fidelity control of long-lived data qubits via a noisy mediator
abstract: Long-lived qubits are attractive for storing quantum information, but they are often difficult to control or couple directly. A common strategy is to use mediator qubits to generate effective interactions for gate implementation. However, the mediator typically has a shorter coherence time than the data qubits, so mediator relaxation and dephasing are expected to limit the achievable gate fidelity. Here, we show that this limitation can be overcome. We present a reset-assisted control method that suppresses mediator-induced errors and enables high-fidelity single- and two-qubit gates on a quantum register of long-lived data qubits. Although mediator quantum jumps render the data-qubit evolution stochastic, repeated mediator reinitialization drives the resulting evolution paths toward the desired target operation. An analytical quantum-trajectory analysis reveals the physical mechanism of error suppression and provides compact fidelity formulas for adapting the method to different platforms. Our results relax the requirement for long mediator coherence, broadening the range of mediators that can support high-fidelity control.

summaries.en: The paper demonstrates a reset-assisted control scheme that mitigates mediator-induced decoherence, allowing high-fidelity single- and two-qubit gates on long-lived data qubits even when the noisy mediator has limited coherence, by using repeated mediator reinitialization and a quantum-trajectory analysis to explain and quantify error suppression.
summaries.zh: 本文提出一种借助重置的控制方案，可抑制噪声介导器引入的退相干，从而在介导器相干性较差的情况下仍在长寿命数据量子比特上实现高保真单量子比特与双量子比特门，并通过重复介导器重初始化结合量子轨迹分析解释错误抑制机制及给出可用于不同平台的保真度公式，从而放宽对介导器相干时间的要求。

title: A New Quantum Algorithm Framework for Integer Order Entropy Estimation
abstract: Entropy estimation for unknown distributions is a basic problem in statistical property estimation. In this paper, we propose a quantum algorithm framework for estimating Rényi entropy with fixed integer order $k\geq 2$. Given purified quantum query-access to a distribution on $n$ symbols, our algorithm estimates its order-$k$ Rényi entropy to within additive error $\epsilon$ using $$\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}\left(\frac{n^{u_k}}{\epsilon^{1-u_k}} + \frac{n^{(k-1)/(2k)}}\epsilon\right)$$ queries, where $u_k=\max_{2\leq j\leq k} \frac{(3k-j)2^{j-2}-k}{k(2^j-1)}$. The main ingredient is a recursive construction of collision states in which intermediate states are retained and reused. We bound both the preparation and reflection costs, and choose the number of retained states at each order so that all recursive steps fit within a common query budget. We combine this construction with a sequence of decreasing probability thresholds, estimating the contribution of the labels found along the way separately from the remaining power sum. A batch estimator gives the required bound in the high-precision regime, and an initial search removes the need for prior knowledge of the power sum.

summaries.en: The paper presents a recursive quantum algorithm framework that estimates the order‑k Rényi entropy (k≥2) of an unknown distribution from purified quantum query access with additive error ε, achieving O(n^{u_k}/epsilon^{1-u_k} + n^{(k-1)/(2k)}/epsilon) queries by reusing intermediate collision states and using thresholding plus batch estimation to handle contributions from found labels and the remaining power sum without prior knowledge.
summaries.zh: 该论文提出一种递归量子算法框架，在已知符号数为 n 的未知分布上并基于纯化量子查询访问，以加性误差 ε 估计阶数 k(当 k≥2) 的 Rényi 熵，并通过保留且复用中间碰撞态、采用递减概率阈值把已找到标签的贡献与剩余幂和分别处理、再结合批量估计来避免对幂和的先验知识，从而以 O(n^{u_k}/epsilon^{1-u_k} + n^{(k-1)/(2k)}/epsilon) 次查询达到所需精度。

title: Flat bands and bound states in the continuum in non-Hermitian pseudospin lattices
abstract: Flat bands support compact localized states (CLSs), whereas bound states in the continuum (BICs) remain spatially localized despite having energies embedded in the continuum of extended states. Here, we investigate the connection between these phenomena in a class of one-dimensional non-Hermitian lattices whose Bloch Hamiltonians take the pseudospin form H(k)=d(k)S. For integer pseudospin, the Hamiltonian intrinsically supports a zero-energy flat band and its associated compact localized states. When the effective pseudospin field has real transverse components and a purely imaginary longitudinal component, increasing non-Hermiticity compresses the dispersive bands toward the intrinsic zero-energy flat band, enabling their spectral overlap within a finite parameter range. The CLSs thus become embedded in the dispersive continuum and emerge as BICs. Adding a momentum-dependent Hermitian component along the gain-loss direction generally removes this spectral overlap without destroying the CLSs. We further extend this spectral mechanism to integer-pseudospin-n systems. These findings establish a connection between intrinsic flat-band localization and BIC formation through non-Hermitian spectral reconstruction.

summaries.en: In non-Hermitian one-dimensional pseudospin lattices with Bloch Hamiltonians H(k)=d(k)S, integer pseudospin yields an intrinsic zero-energy flat band with compact localized states that become bound states in the continuum as non-Hermiticity compresses dispersive bands to overlap spectrally, a mechanism that persists for higher integer-pseudospin-n systems and can be disrupted by added momentum-dependent Hermitian terms while retaining the CLSs.
summaries.zh: 在非厄米一维赝自旋晶格（H(k)=d(k)S）中，整数赝自旋会内禀地产生零能量平带及其紧束缚局域态；当非厄米性增强使色散能带被压缩并在有限参数范围内与该平带实现谱重叠时，这些紧束缚局域态会嵌入色散连续谱并转化为连续谱中的束缚态（BIC），该谱机制也适用于更高的整数赝自旋n系统，并且加入增益-损耗方向上动量依赖的厄米分量通常会消除谱重叠但不会破坏CLS。

title: A receiver-side approach to confirm phase randomization in BB84 time-bin QKD with weak coherent pulses
abstract: In quantum cryptography using time-bin BB84 protocols, the relative phase of symbol pulses has to be random to avoid vulnerability to coherent attacks. Typically this phase randomization is checked on the sender side. Here, we propose a protocol for monitoring and confirming phase randomization independently on the receiver side during operation. The proposed method can be implemented on the single-photon level without the need for any physical adaptation of the receiver. This can provide an additional tool for monitoring against possible eavesdropping attempts that affect the phase randomization.

summaries.en: The paper proposes a receiver-side monitoring protocol to confirm phase randomization in BB84 time-bin QKD with weak coherent pulses without modifying the receiver hardware, enabling detection of eavesdropping attempts that disturb phase randomization.
summaries.zh: 本文提出一种在弱相干脉冲的时间隙BB84量子密钥分发中由接收方侧进行相位随机化确认的监测协议，且无需对接收端硬件做任何改动即可在单光子层面实现，从而为抵御可能破坏相位随机化的窃听攻击提供额外手段。

title: Cooperativity-enhanced single-photon emission in a topological quantum emitter chain
abstract: Single-photon emitters are one of the key elements in state-of-the art quantum technologies, yet optimizing and manipulating their emission requires precise fabrication of the emitter systems themselves. Here, we propose a route to tailored single-photon emission by exploiting cooperative effects in a topological single-photon emitter chain. Although the involvement of multiple emitters normally suppresses single-photon emission, we show that localized topological edge modes restore single-photon emission and protect against local perturbations. At the same time, cooperative effects occur due to the collective nature of the edge modes, leading to directional emission and linewidth narrowing. Our findings open new possibilities for tailoring single-photon emission by combining cooperativity and topological effects.

summaries.en: The paper proposes using cooperativity and topological edge modes in a chain of quantum emitters to restore and tailor single-photon emission, yielding directional output and narrowed linewidths while protecting against local perturbations.
summaries.zh: 论文提出在量子发射体链中结合相干性与拓扑边缘模来恢复并定制单光子发射，通过集体边缘模实现定向发射与线宽变窄，并抵御局部扰动。

title: To predict or to persist: how decoherence shapes learning in a spin-qubit quantum reservoir
abstract: In this work we investigate how dephasing and the choice of measured observables affect learning in a simulated six-qubit spin chain with Markovian dissipation and exact expectation-value readout. For externally driven nonlinear autoregressive moving-average signals, combining single- and two-qubit observables gives better predictions than a population-only readout at comparable polynomial feature counts. Most of the configurations we tested become more accurate than a reference with relaxation and dephasing disabled, most strongly at $T_2=1\,\mu$s, where total memory capacity drops, and still at $T_2=5$-$10\,\mu$s, where memory is only redistributed across delays. For autonomous generation, we train the readout with scheduled sampling and iterative dataset aggregation to expose it to states reached under its own feedback. We do not find a clear systematic dependence of limit-cycle persistence on coherence across the reservoir ensemble. For chaotic forecasting, in contrast, prediction horizons at $T_2=1\,\mu$s shorten in all 10 reservoir realizations relative to that reference. For the noise-driven strange non-chaotic attractor, the model produces a smooth, approximately closed orbit, and neither captures the target's scatter nor follows its trajectory pointwise. We conclude that, within this simulated reservoir, the impact of coherence depends strongly on the task.
subjects: Quantum Physics (quant-ph) ; Mesoscale and Nanoscale Physics (cond-mat.mes-hall); Chaotic Dynamics (nlin.CD)

summaries.en: The paper shows, in a simulated six-qubit spin-chain reservoir with Markovian dephasing/relaxation and exact expectation-value readout, that using both single- and two-qubit observables can improve prediction over population-only readout, while decoherence’s effect on learning varies strongly by task—reducing memory capacity and shortening chaotic forecast horizons at low coherence but not yielding a clear link to limit-cycle persistence, and partially capturing noise-driven attractors only in a smooth, not pointwise, way.
summaries.zh: 论文在具有马尔可夫退相干与弛豫、并能进行精确期望值读出的六量子比特自旋链量子储备库中表明：在可比的多项式特征规模下，联合单量子比特与双量子比特观测量的读出比仅用群体（人口）读出更能提升预测，而退相干对学习的影响随任务显著变化——在低相干度时会降低记忆容量并缩短混沌预测视野，但对极限环持续性缺乏明确的相干度关联；对噪声驱动的奇异非混沌吸引子则只能生成平滑、近似闭合的轨道，难以同时捕捉目标散布并逐点跟随其轨迹。

title: CAVQS: Context-Aware Variational Quantum Circuit Synthesis via Unitary Redistribution and Dynamic Reconstruction
abstract: Variational quantum circuit synthesis jointly searches circuit structure and continuous parameters to reduce costly two-qubit gates, but block-based workflows typically instantiate blocks independently, limiting simplification across block boundaries. Moreover, fully unitary synthesis does not exploit opportunities created by permitted output measurements and classical feedforward. We present CAVQS, a context-aware variational synthesis framework that combines unitary redistribution and dynamic reconstruction. First, CAVQS uses QR decomposition to transfer unitary factors between overlapping blocks, preserving the overall transformation while reshaping local synthesis targets to enable cross-block reductions. Second, for blocks that precede permitted terminal measurements, CAVQS constructs ancilla-free dynamic implementations with a CNOT-budgeted pre-measurement search and analytic branch-unitary construction, thereby minimizing expected CNOT cost. Across random-circuit targets, CAVQS reduces mean two-qubit gate counts by 28.79%-42.52%, 2.05%-52.62%, and 30.51%-74.64% relative to QFAST, SQUANDER, and Fast-USYN, respectively, on common successful instances. On 4--6-qubit quantum algorithm benchmarks, the corresponding reductions are 27.27%-36.77%, 20.65%-69.10%, and 36.31%-71.88%, respectively.

summaries.en: The paper introduces CAVQS, a context-aware variational quantum circuit synthesis method that uses unitary redistribution via QR-based decomposition and ancilla-free dynamic reconstruction to enable cross-block two-qubit gate reductions and lower expected CNOT costs while exploiting permitted measurement contexts and achieves substantial reductions versus prior block-based methods and benchmarks.
summaries.zh: 论文提出CAVQS，一种面向上下文的变分量子电路综合方法，通过基于QR分解的幺正重分配与无辅助比特的动态重构来实现跨模块的双量子比特门减少，并在利用允许的测量上下文以降低期望CNOT成本的同时，在与既有区块化方法及算法基准对比中取得了显著的性能提升。

title: Stitching Quantum Codes into Quilts: Universal Logic with no Ancillary Qubits
abstract: Proposals abound for performing fault-tolerant logical Pauli-product measurements between quantum codes beyond the surface code. We introduce a new construction, the code quilt, whereby a target joint logical operator of two or more codeblocks is directly measured without the use of an ancillary system. We construct explicit circuits to perform a logical measurement using the quilt construction, which also require no physical qubits beyond the ancillas already in place to perform idle syndrome extraction on the codeblocks in question. We give a detailed structural analysis of the construction, which is based on a subsystem code, and provide several sets of sufficient conditions under which the relevant code-capacity distance is preserved. We give two variants of the protocol. The first, where the gauge generators of the subsystem code are measured directly, is provably not fault tolerant in the large-distance limit but admits a particularly practical circuit implementation in which the physical qubit degree increases by at most two. The second has more favourable asymptotic properties, although we do not prove its fault tolerance in the general case. We then perform an extensive empirical analysis of the technique, in particular of the first variant, as applied to bivariate bicycle and surface codes, finding code-capacity-distance preserving quilts for measuring 25,000 randomly selected logical operators. We optimise to find sparse and decongested detector bases for each and, for a randomly selected subset, find circuits that we estimate to be distance preserving. Finally, we perform decoding experiments on a subset of these circuits and find that their logical error probability is comparable to that of idle memory for operations involving the 144-qubit bivariate bicycle code and distance-12 rotated surface code at physical error rates between $1.5\times 10^{-3}$ and $3\times 10^{-3}$.

summaries.en: The paper introduces a “code quilt” construction that enables fault-tolerant-style joint logical Pauli-product measurements between multiple quantum codeblocks without any additional ancillary qubits, providing circuits, structural conditions for distance preservation, two protocol variants, and empirical results on specific code families showing competitive logical error rates versus idle memory.
summaries.zh: 本文提出“代码拼布（code quilt）”构造，可在不使用额外辅助量子比特的情况下直接测量多个量子码块之间的联合逻辑保利乘积（Pauli-product）算符，并给出实现电路、距离保持的结构性充分条件、两种协议变体及在特定码族上的大量实证分析，结果表明其逻辑错误率与空闲记忆相当。

title: Tunable Ground-State Entanglement in Fully Connected Quantum Systems: From Logarithmic to Volume-Law Scaling
abstract: Entanglement scaling is a central probe of the complexity of quantum many-body ground states, yet once geometric locality is absent, it can depend sensitively on the structure and normalization of interactions. For fully connected Hamiltonians with the natural Kac normalization, nondegenerate gapped ground states are known to obey a logarithmic entanglement bound. Here we ask how the ground-state entanglement changes when this interaction normalization is continuously relaxed away from the Kac scale. We answer this question by constructing an explicit all-to-all bipartite Hamiltonian of $n$ qubits with Fourier pairing amplitudes and pairwise interaction strength proportional to $n^{-\kappa}$. For sufficiently small fixed coupling, we prove that every pure ground state has entanglement entropy $\Theta(n^{2-2\kappa} \log n)$ for $1/2<\kappa\leq1$ and $\Theta(n)$ at $\kappa=1/2$. We further show that the ground state is unique and separated from the rest of the spectrum by a system-size-independent gap for $3/4 \leq \kappa \leq 1$, while weak-coupling analysis and numerical calculations suggest that the gap remains open also for $1/2 \leq \kappa < 3/4$. Thus, varying only the interaction normalization yields a controlled hierarchy from logarithmic scaling at the natural Kac normalization $\kappa=1$ to increasingly strong subextensive entanglement and ultimately to a volume law, showing that even an arbitrarily weak relaxation of this normalization precludes a universal logarithmic entanglement bound.
subjects: Quantum Physics (quant-ph) ; Disordered Systems and Neural Networks (cond-mat.dis-nn); Statistical Mechanics (cond-mat.stat-mech); Mathematical Physics (math-ph)

summaries.en: The paper constructs an all-to-all bipartite n-qubit Hamiltonian with pairwise couplings scaled as n^{-\kappa} and proves that, for sufficiently small fixed coupling, ground-state entanglement entropy scales as Θ(n^{2-2\kappa}\log n) for 1/2<\kappa\le1 but becomes Θ(n) at \kappa=1/2, with a unique gapped ground state for 3/4\le\kappa\le1 and likely an open gap for 1/2\le\kappa<3/4, demonstrating that relaxing Kac normalization drives a tunable transition from logarithmic to volume-law entanglement and eliminates any universal logarithmic bound.
summaries.zh: 本文构造了一个$n$比特全连接双部分玻色型（all-to-all bipartite）哈密顿量，其两两相互作用强度按$n^{-\kappa}$随系统规模归一化，并在足够小且固定的耦合下证明：当$1/2<\kappa\le1$时基态纠缠熵满足$\Theta(n^{2-2\kappa}\log n)$，而在$\kappa=1/2$时达到$\Theta(n)$；同时基态在$3/4\le\kappa\le1$范围内是唯一且与其余谱之间存在与系统规模无关的能隙（并且弱耦合分析与数值计算表明在$1/2\le\kappa<3/4$时能隙大概率仍保持开启），从而表明仅通过放松Kac归一化就能在从对数尺度（$\kappa=1$）到越来越强的超对数但仍次扩展纠缠，最终到体律纠缠之间实现可控层级，并因此排除了纠缠对数尺度的普适上界。

title: When lies look like noise: certifying untrusted entanglement swapping
abstract: Entanglement swapping lets quantum repeaters distribute entanglement over long distances, a prerequisite for the quantum internet. We study its security in a noisy network whose intermediate nodes perform the quantum operations faithfully but may misreport the classical outcome that end users rely on. We show that the ideal functionality of entanglement swapping cannot be realised, because it gives the adversary no influence over the delivered state, whereas a node that relabels its report does have such influence. Including honest noise in the ideal setting does not help unless it also concedes a bounded fraction of misreported pairs. We therefore propose a cut-and-choose protocol that tests a random subset of pairs to certify the rest. Since no test can distinguish a misreport from readout noise, the protocol certifies the error above a pre-agreed minimum noise level, which is the misreport rate under our threat model. This yields a quality-of-service guarantee, in which a failure witnesses that the node did not deliver as agreed. Unlike verification schemes that consume the state they certify, the untested pairs remain available for use, with a finite-size guarantee. Certifying a 1% misreport rate on 10^6 pairs costs 10^4 to 1.7x10^5 test pairs, for minimum noise levels ranging from 0 to 5%. The main cost is memory, since 1% requires holding 10^5 to 10^6 pairs at once, far beyond the capacity of today's quantum memories. Verifying and releasing in blocks ties the memory to the block size at the cost of a weaker rate: a (10^4)-qubit memory certifies 14% on 4.7x10^5 delivered pairs.
subjects: Quantum Physics (quant-ph) ; Distributed, Parallel, and Cluster Computing (cs.DC)

summaries.en: The paper shows that entanglement swapping in untrusted quantum repeaters can’t be perfectly certified in an idealized way because misreporting classical outcomes lets an adversary affect the delivered entanglement, and it proposes a cut-and-choose protocol that tests a random subset to guarantee (with finite-size bounds) that the remaining pairs have an error rate at least as large as the misreport rate, trading off test cost against memory limits.
summaries.zh: 本文证明在不受信任的量子中继中，纠缠交换无法以理想方式被完美认证，因为中继可能通过错误的经典结果报告来影响最终交付的纠缠态，并提出一种抽样切分（cut-and-choose）协议，通过测试随机子集为其余纠缠对提供有限规模的质量保证，其代价在于测试数量与量子存储器容量的权衡。

title: Hamiltonian Stabilization of the Two-Photon Dicke Model
abstract: Collective two-photon light--matter interactions enable pair amplification but can destroy spectral confinement, preventing a stable thermodynamic bright phase. We show that a positive Kac-scaled number-Kerr interaction renders the two-photon Dicke Hamiltonian of \(N\) emitters lower-bounded at all couplings while preserving its generalized \(\mathbb Z_4\) symmetry. We determine the exact zero-temperature thermodynamic energy density with \(O(N^{-1})\) finite-size control and obtain the global phase diagram. A bright minimum is born at a saddle-node and exchanges global stability with the normal minimum at coexistence, producing a discontinuous photon-density jump. Symmetry-resolved exact diagonalization through \(N=128\) supports the predicted density jump and an exponentially closing same-sector normal--bright tunneling gap. Spectral collapse thus becomes the singular zero-Kerr point of a first-order phase diagram, identifying a Hamiltonian route to stabilizing pair amplification.

summaries.en: The paper shows that adding a positive, Kac-scaled Kerr interaction to the two-photon Dicke Hamiltonian preserves its generalized Z4 symmetry while making it lower-bounded for all couplings, enabling an exactly controlled thermodynamic phase diagram where a discontinuous bright-phase photon-density jump arises via a saddle-node and stability exchange, supported by symmetry-resolved exact diagonalization and linked to an exponentially small tunneling gap.
summaries.zh: 论文表明，在两光子迪克哈密顿量中加入正的、Kac 缩放的 Kerr 相互作用可在所有耦合下保持广义 Z4 对称并使其处处下有界，从而得到可精确控阶的热力学相图：亮相最小值在鞍结处诞生并在共存点与常规最小值发生全局稳定性交换，导致光子密度的非连续跃迁；这一结论通过 N=128 的对称分辨精确对角化得到支持，并与同扇区范式-亮态隧穿的指数级减小能隙及“零 Kerr 点处的谱坍塌是第一类相变奇点”这一结论相联系，指明了稳定成对放大的哈密顿量路径。

title: On the design of sequential quantum repeaters with error detection
abstract: Long-distance, trust-free quantum communications rely on the development of scalable quantum repeater schemes. Sequential entanglement generation with error detection is a promising approach that combines manageable implementation requirements with a hop-by-hop architecture compatible with existing classical infrastructure. In this paper, we investigate key design choices for such schemes over a repeater chain using quantum key distribution as a benchmark. We find that simple quantum error-detecting codes, such as repetition codes or quantum parity codes, perform well under near-term hardware assumptions and outperform strategies without any encoding. In particular, we show that two-qubit repetition codes may well be all that we need to implement in many practical scenarios. We also examine different architectures for the generation of initial entanglement and assess their merits. Additionally, we show that moderate improvements in some hardware components can partially mitigate the slow technological progress of others.

summaries.en: The paper studies how to design sequential quantum repeaters with error detection over a repeater chain, using quantum key distribution as a benchmark, and shows that simple quantum error-detecting codes like repetition or quantum parity codes—possibly even two-qubit repetition codes—can outperform no-encoding strategies under near-term hardware assumptions while different initial-entanglement architectures and moderate hardware improvements can further alleviate bottlenecks.
summaries.zh: 本文研究了在量子中继链上带有差错检测的顺序量子中继器的设计方案，并以量子密钥分发为基准，表明在近期开工条件下，诸如重复码或量子奇偶校验码等简单量子差错检测码（在许多实际场景中甚至可能只需实现两量子比特重复码）会优于不编码的策略，同时分析了初始纠缠生成的不同架构，并指出对部分硬件的适度改进能够在一定程度上缓解各组件技术进展缓慢带来的问题。

title: Moiré-Enabled Recursive Phase Unwrapping for Differential Atom Interferometry
abstract: Weak equivalence principle tests comparing different elements may be more sensitive to violations than those comparing isotopes. However, differences in effective wave vector complicate common-mode rejection of vibration noise. We propose a Moiré-enabled recursive phase unwrapping (MRPU) method for differential measurements with dual-species atom interferometers. The method exploits the moiré structure of the joint phase likelihood and temporal acceleration correlations to unwrap both phases and determine the relative acceleration. We implemented an $^{85}$Rb $\mathrm{D_1/D_2}$ line dual-scale-factor interferometer with an identical normalized transfer function and a large effective wave-vector difference to emulate different atomic species. Under $40\,\mathrm{rad}$ equivalent vibrational noise, this method achieved phase unwrapping over 5000 consecutive measurements, with a relative-acceleration Allan deviation of $1.47\times10^{-8}g$ at 997 shots. Numerical simulations under random vibrations and slow drifts show a $9.76 - 26.03\,\mathrm{dB}$ increase in the tolerable narrowband vibration amplitude. This method is promising for weak equivalence principle tests based on different atomic species, dark matter and dark energy detection, and high-dynamic-range atomic gravimetry.

summaries.en: The paper proposes a moiré-enabled recursive phase unwrapping method for dual-species atom interferometers to jointly unwrap differential phases and extract relative acceleration despite large effective wave-vector differences, demonstrating >5000-measurement unwrapping under <40 rad vibration noise and improved narrowband vibration tolerance in simulations.
summaries.zh: 论文提出一种利用莫尔花纹结构的递归相位解缠方法，用于双物种原子干涉仪在有效波矢差较大的情况下同时解缠差分相位并提取相对加速度，实验中在小于40弧度的振动噪声下实现超过5000次连续解缠，并在仿真中显著提升了窄带振动幅度容限。
